resources.string: Anonymous, end-to-end encrypted conversations. No phone number, no email.
Create or open a session to talk to %1$s.
Privee has no central server: anyone can run one. Enter the address of the Privee server you want to use, for example your own deployment. Your session and keys belong to that server.
This is not a valid server address.
The server must use HTTPS (an address starting with https://).
Cannot reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
This is not a Privee server.
This Privee server uses API version %1$s, which this app does not support. Update the app or ask the server administrator.
A session is your anonymous identity. Share its name with the people you want to talk to.
Use the session name and recovery phrase you chose when creating the session.
24–72 letters, digits or dashes. Leave empty for a random one.
No recovery phrase: anyone who knows the name can log in.
Session name or recovery phrase is not correct.
Something went wrong (HTTP %1$d). Please try again.
Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Check the entered values and try again.
Talk to me privately on Privee: %1$s\nIn the Privee app: %2$s
Not a session name or a share link of this server.
Delete all encryption keys and history of this session from this device? You will need to reset encryption to chat again.
Encryption for this session was reset on another device, so this device can no longer send or receive messages.
This device has no encryption keys for this session. Reset the encryption identity to continue; messages sent to your previous device will not be readable here.
Your contacts will be asked to verify your new safety number.
There is no session named “%1$s”. Check the name or link and try again.
%1$s\'s safety number has changed. They may have reset encryption or logged in on a new device. Verify it with them before continuing.
%1$s has no encryption keys yet. Your message will be delivered once they open Privee.
The message could not be sent. It will be retried automatically.
Could not fetch new messages. Retrying when the connection is back.
Messages are end-to-end encrypted and stored only on your devices.
Compare these numbers with %1$s in person or over another channel. If they match, your conversation is secure.
Delete all messages of this conversation from this device?
This message could not be decrypted.
This link to %1$s is for the server %2$s, but you are using %3$s. The session %1$s on %3$s may belong to someone else.
This link to %1$s doesn\'t say which server it is for, but you are using %2$s. The session %1$s on %2$s may belong to someone else.
Connecting or reconnecting to the chat server
Listening is enabled, but the service is not running. Open settings to retry.
Background listening could not start. Check notification settings and retry.
Keep a direct connection to your Privee server while the app is closed. This uses more battery and displays an ongoing status notification. No Google services or push distributor are required.

If messages are delayed with the screen off, allow unrestricted battery use for Privee in Android settings. Android may warn that this uses more battery; this is an optional trade-off for background alerts. Only accept it if you want this feature. Setting names vary by device.
Android can still stop the app. Force stop prevents alerts until you reopen Privee. Messages that arrive while disconnected may not generate an alert; open the conversation to catch up.
While enabled, direct listening handles alerts instead of UnifiedPush. When disabled, an installed UnifiedPush distributor can still deliver alerts.
Notifications or a required notification channel are disabled. Allow them in Android notification settings to receive alerts.
Privee is exempt from Android battery optimization. Other device restrictions can still apply.
Android could not open these settings. Open Privee\'s app settings manually.
Could not save the background listening setting. Please retry.
Only you can see this hint, and only on this device. Don\'t write their name: anyone who unlocks this device could read it.
Long-press a conversation to add a private hint.
